utilities.policy_body: Internal points and Internal FGO are platform-only benefit and governance records. They are not cash, not an e-wallet balance, not an investment asset, and cannot be withdrawn or redeemed for cash.
utilities.card.app_download.title: Download Timeblock app
utilities.card.app_download.body: Install Timeblock from the browser on desktop, Android, or iOS before a store release.
utilities.app_download.title: Use Timeblock like an app on desktop and mobile
utilities.app_download.body: Timeblock is now prepared as a Progressive Web App. Members, businesses, and operators can install it from the browser without App Store or Google Play distribution in this phase.
utilities.app_download.install_hint: If the install prompt is not available, use the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
utilities.app_download.ready_hint: Install prompt is ready on this browser.
utilities.app_download.manual_hint: Use the browser menu if the prompt does not open automatically.
utilities.app_download.done_hint: Timeblock has been installed on this device.
utilities.app_download.error_hint: App install support is not available in this browser session.
utilities.app_download.step_desktop: Desktop: open Timeblock in Chrome or Edge, then choose Install Timeblock from the address bar or browser menu.
utilities.app_download.step_android: Android: open Timeblock in Chrome, then choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
utilities.app_download.step_ios: iOS: open Timeblock in Safari, tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
